**Coaching Note:**

Don't just look for checks and captures—quiet moves can be deadly! Here, d5 breaks open Black's pawn chain. After Black captures on d5, your c-pawn marches forward to c6. When Black takes it, you push b4 and your a-pawn promotes. The key insight: each capture forces Black to clear one obstacle while you set up the next one. Look for "quiet" advances that create unstoppable passed pawns by forcing a breakthrough sequence.
